# Local teacher weights

See [data preparation](../../docs/data_preparation.md#teacher-weights).
Set `TRACK4WORLD_CHECKPOINTS_ROOT` to the external directory containing
`track4world_da3.pth`, `DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE-1.1/`, and `torchvision/`.
The export Shell defaults to the repository-level `checkpoints/Track4World`.
